notes.title: 【Announcement】TGS 2025 & Next Fest Commemorative Update!!
notes.content: [p]To celebrate [b]Tokyo Game Show 2025[/b] and the [b]October Steam Next Fest[/b], the demo of [i]RETRYS[/i] is getting a [b]major update[/b]![/p][p]We’ve added and improved many elements, including character expressions, a new chase mode, new facilities, and fresh events.[/p][p]I’ve been updating non-stop this past month—totally exhausted 😁[/p][p]Here are the full details of the update!![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🆕 New Features & Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Added a [b]Chase Mode[/b]: when discovered by enemies, thrilling pursuits begin![/p][/*][*][p]Expanded situations where bug programs can be used (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Added reactions when choosing the wrong bug program (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Major renovation of the Cat Mansion (a lot of effort went in!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added brand-new gameplay to the Castle Tower (really made me think!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a secret room under the tavern (what happens if you sleep in the bed…?).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a jar specialty shop in town (hehe).[/p][/*][*][p]Added the mansion of a wealthy noble, with a mysterious new character.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the route of the first farmer puzzle to include a light detour.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 Visual Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Added eyes and mouths to character sprites (looks nice!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added bug creature character art (what do you think?).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the effect colors when defeating bugs (a bit more horror).[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the cat search event in the Cat Mansion (with retro ’Showa’ references).[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Game Over screen.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📖 Story & World-Building[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted event dialogue to better fit story and world (still improving!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added an episode with a boy and his grandmother in town (slightly tear-jerking).[/p][/*][*][p]Added dancers to the tavern (twirl, twirl!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added hints in the inn (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Added hints in the Lost Forest (based on feedback).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 UI & Presentation Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]glitch noise effects[/b] to maps with bug creatures (easier to notice).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted message window size for better readability (a subtle but nice change).[/p][/*][*][p]Changed map effect draw order to appear behind pictures (based on feedback).[/p][/*][*][p]Improved review flow: now you can open the store page directly in your browser (please leave us a review—yoroshiku!).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues occurring in the Cat Mansion.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected missing images on the CRT monitor.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unnecessary white edges from character images.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 🤝 Let’s shake hands at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.content:
[p]📢 Just a little announcement:
[/p][p]I’m heading to Tokyo Game Show 2025.
(No, I’m not exhibiting this time, lol.)[/p][p][/p][p]For me, it’s a yearly tradition to meet industry friends and acquaintances at Makuhari.[/p][p]This year, I’ll be bringing flyers for [b]RETRYS[/b] and handing them out like crazy![/p][p][/p][p]If you’d like one (or just want to meet and chat), please DM me on the official X account(@retrys_project).
I’d love to meet you in person if possible![/p]

notes.title: Good news for those who haven't played "RETRYS" yet!
notes.content:
[p]🫵 [b]You there! Yes, you—the one who downloaded “RETRYS” but hasn’t started your adventure yet![/b]
Oh yes, I know exactly who you are. Don’t think you can hide it![/p][p][/p][p]🎉 Congratulations!
That long “aging” period in your library wasn’t a waste at all…[/p][p]Because the demo has just received a [b]major update![/b][/p][p]This brand-new version, with the motto [i]“The most satisfying first experience,”[/i] brings huge upgrades to both story and gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]😲 [b]Straight to the climax?[/b]
From the prologue, you’ll be pulled right into a mysterious scene...[/p][p]And now, a completely new event has been added that digs into the heart of the story—along with the appearance of a [i]mysterious character.[/i][/p][p]This isn’t just about gags anymore—you’ll feel the depth of the story, too.[/p][p][/p][p]🥰 [b]Funnier adventures, smoother than ever[/b]
The comedy scenes have been powered up![/p][p]Maps, conversation pacing, even the audio balance have been polished to make the adventure stress-free and snappy.[/p][p]Your precious time will now be focused solely on what matters: [i]having fun![/i][/p][p][/p][p]⏱️ [b]Just 15 minutes[/b]
We’ve trimmed it to a bite-sized play session that even busy adventurers can enjoy.[/p][p]But maybe you’re thinking: [i]“Wait, that’s it?”[/i]
Hehehe… don’t worry, I know you well. You’ll see for yourself.[/p][p][/p][p]🐲 [b]So, hero! Pull “RETRYS” out from your pile of backlogs![/b]
Become the bug-slaying hero—and the savior of us developers![/p][p]We’ll be waiting for you with plenty of bugs prepared![/p][p][/p][p][b]Aug 29, 2025 — Studio Garage Inc., Hideyuki Ikeda[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]📝 Update Highlights[/h3][p][b]New story & events[/b][/p][list][*][p]Completely overhauled the prologue, with brand-new event scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the “Day 1 night” scene with a new key event introducing a mysterious character[/p][/*][*][p]Revised the demo’s Day 4 ending, adding fresh presentation and suspense[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay & map improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enhanced the humor of the first bug encounter on Day 1[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new laugh-inducing bug in the Day 1 sewers[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked map layouts in Day 1 sewers and Day 2 altar for smoother play[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hint clarity in the Day 2 forest[/p][/*][*][p]Removed objects that interfered with controls[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Presentation & text updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Strengthened event direction at Day 1’s goal and Day 2’s castle finale[/p][/*][*][p]Added CRT shadow effects to highlight Charlie’s presence[/p][/*][*][p]Revised all text for conciseness and better pacing[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked major characters’ dialogue to ensure consistent personalities[/p][/*][*][p]Refined the cat mansion dialogue on Day 3 for smoother flow[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI & sound adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Differentiated window colors and sound effects between character dialogue and system messages[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced all audio for long, comfortable play sessions[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new feature at the end of Day 1: return to title screen or jump to the Steam store page[/p][/*][/list]
